import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    a = []
    for _ in range(n):
        a.append(int(data[idx]))
        idx += 1
        
    r1 = int(data[idx])
    c1 = int(data[idx + 1])
    r2 = int(data[idx + 2])
    c2 = int(data[idx + 3])
    
    r1 -= 1
    r2 -= 1
    
    moves = abs(r2 - r1)
    
    current_r = r1
    current_c = c1
    
    while current_r != r2:
        target_len = a[current_r]
        max_pos = target_len + 1
        if current_c > max_pos:
            current_c = max_pos
        
        if current_r < r2:
            current_r += 1
        else:
            current_r -= 1
        
        next_line_len = a[current_r]
        next_max_pos = next_line_len + 1
        if current_c > next_max_pos:
            current_c = next_max_pos
    
    moves += abs(current_c - c2)
    
    print(moves)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
